title: [R] Autonomous Mathematical Discovery in an Open-World Multi-Agent Environment
summary: Abstract:We study autonomous mathematical discovery in the Station, an open-world multi-agent environment in which AI agents from different model families pursue a shared research goal without a central coordinator or scripted pipeline. Agents choose their own research directions, conduct experiments, collaborate, and build a shared scientific literature.Across 12 construction problems from the AlphaEvolve catalogue and two additional case studies, the Station obtained results novel relative to the prior literature on five problems: a new infinite family of finite-field Kakeya sets, new exact 604-point kissing configurations in dimension 11, new records for the discretized Kakeya needle and sign uncertainty problems, and a substantially improved lower bound for Erdős's minimum-overlap problem.Agents also discovered novel infinite families for Book Ramsey numbers. Importantly, the agents produced not only numerical constructions but also theorems and analyses explaining how those constructions work, making the results more interpretable and easier for mathematicians to build upon. We release all raw agent dialogues, proofs, and verification code, providing a transparent record of how these discoveries emerged.submitted by/u/progenitor414[link][comments]
title_es: Agentes de IA descubren nuevos resultados matemáticos en entorno multiagente
bajada: Múltiples agentes de IA colaboraron autónomamente en el proyecto Station para resolver problemas matemáticos abiertos, descubriendo nuevas familias infinitas y configuraciones de besos. Este trabajo demuestra el potencial de sistemas multiagente para investigación científica real.
bajada_en: Multiple AI agents autonomously collaborated in the Station project to solve open mathematical problems, discovering new infinite families and kissing configurations. This work demonstrates the potential of multi-agent systems for real scientific research.

title: Sony Music, Warner sue Anthropic, alleging a “brazen campaign” of intellectual property theft
summary: This latest lawsuit is particularly broad and homes in on accusations of illegal piracy.
title_es: Sony y Warner demandan a Anthropic por robo de propiedad intelectual
bajada: Sony Music y Warner Chappell presentaron una demanda contra Anthropic por piratería de decenas de miles de obras protegidas, reclamando hasta $150,000 por obra. Este caso expande la batalla legal sobre derechos de autor en entrenamiento de IA.
bajada_en: Sony Music and Warner Chappell filed suit against Anthropic for piracy of tens of thousands of copyrighted works, claiming up to $150,000 per work. This case expands the legal battle over copyright in AI training.

title: Caterpillar is bringing to AI deployment what it learned from automating mining
summary: Caterpillar has spent decades putting autonomous machines to work at remote mining sites. It's now bringing that experience to AI deployment.
title_es: Caterpillar aplica experiencia en minería autónoma al despliegue de IA
bajada: Caterpillar traslada décadas de experiencia automatizando operaciones mineras remotas hacia estrategias de despliegue de IA. Esta aproximación industrial podría cambiar cómo las empresas implementan sistemas de IA a escala.
bajada_en: Caterpillar is bringing decades of experience automating remote mining operations to AI deployment strategies. This industrial approach could reshape how enterprises implement AI systems at scale.

title: Inside Meta’s push to put robots to work in data centers
summary: The company is testing robots on tasks that can performed by technicians.
title_es: Meta prueba robots en centros de datos para automatizar tareas técnicas
bajada: Meta está testando robots para realizar tareas que actualmente ejecutan técnicos en sus centros de datos. Esta iniciativa busca optimizar operaciones de infraestructura crítica mediante automatización.
bajada_en: Meta is testing robots to perform tasks currently handled by technicians in its data centers. The initiative aims to optimize critical infrastructure operations through automation.

title: Nvidia’s AI advantage is moving beyond the GPU
summary: The new generation of data center systems is increasing efficiency with smarter traffic control instead of just more processor cycles.
title_es: Ventaja de Nvidia en IA se expande más allá de GPUs
bajada: Nvidia está mejorando la eficiencia de sistemas de data center con control inteligente de tráfico en lugar de solo aumentar ciclos de procesador. Esta evolución marca un cambio en la estrategia de ventaja competitiva de la empresa.
bajada_en: Nvidia is improving data center system efficiency with intelligent traffic control rather than just more processor cycles. This evolution marks a shift in the company's competitive advantage strategy.

title: Texas Governor Abbott blocks funding for more Flock cameras
summary: As backlash grows over Flock's AI surveillance cameras, Texas Governor Greg Abbott has frozen state spending on them. The move came just ahead of the publication of a Texas Tribune investigation that revealed the state spent over $30 million on Flock cameras. That money was primarily raised by tacking a $1 fee onto insurance policies, […]
title_es: Gobernador de Texas congela fondos para cámaras de vigilancia Flock con IA
bajada: Greg Abbott bloqueó el financiamiento estatal para cámaras de vigilancia Flock tras críticas por privacidad. Texas gastó $30 millones en la tecnología, lo que genera debates sobre vigilancia basada en IA.
bajada_en: Governor Greg Abbott froze state funding for Flock AI surveillance cameras amid privacy backlash. Texas spent $30 million on the technology, fueling debates about AI-based surveillance.

title: Fair Work Commission condemns 'plain wrong' AI legal advice
title_es: Comisión australiana rechaza consejo legal incorrecto generado por IA
bajada: Una comisión de justicia laboral australiana condenó asesoramiento legal generado por IA como "fundamentalmente equivocado". El caso subraya riesgos críticos de usar LLMs para profesiones reguladas sin validación humana.
bajada_en: An Australian labor justice commission condemned AI-generated legal advice as "plain wrong." The case underscores critical risks of using LLMs for regulated professions without human validation.

title: Claude Session URL appended to commit messages and PR descriptions by default
title_es: Claude agrega URLs de sesión a commits y PRs por defecto
bajada: Se detectó que Claude Code añade automáticamente URLs de sesión a mensajes de commit y descripciones de PR, levantando preocupaciones sobre privacidad de datos. Anthropic debe revisar esta configuración por defecto.
bajada_en: Claude Code was found to automatically append session URLs to commit messages and PR descriptions, raising data privacy concerns. Anthropic needs to review this default behavior.

title: Warp builds self-improving agents on Claude
title_es: Warp construye agentes automejorador sobre Claude
bajada: Warp publicó su enfoque para construir agentes de IA que mejoran automáticamente usando Claude como base. Representa un caso de uso práctico de agentes autónomos en herramientas de desarrollo.
bajada_en: Warp shared its approach to building self-improving AI agents using Claude as a foundation. It represents a practical use case of autonomous agents in developer tools.

title: Debian votes to allow "responsible use of generative AI"
title_es: Debian aprueba uso responsable de IA generativa
bajada: La comunidad de Debian votó para permitir el uso responsable de IA generativa en el proyecto. Esta decisión refleja la creciente integración de herramientas de IA en ecosistemas open-source tradicionales.
bajada_en: The Debian community voted to allow responsible use of generative AI in the project. This decision reflects growing integration of AI tools in traditional open-source ecosystems.

title: How to Run a Chatbot on Your Own Computer
summary: Installing a large language model on your personal computer gives you a handy digital assistant that won’t compromise your data privacy.
title_es: Guía: ejecutar chatbots locales en tu computadora personal
bajada: Wired explora cómo instalar LLMs en computadoras personales para obtener asistentes digitales sin comprometer privacidad de datos. Una opción viable para developers que prefieren control local sobre infraestructura cloud.
bajada_en: Wired explores how to install LLMs on personal computers for digital assistants without compromising data privacy. A viable option for developers preferring local control over cloud infrastructure.
